howToUse.title: Section & Spray
howToUse.instruction: Part your dry or damp hair into clean sections. Hold the floral-labeled spray bottle 2-3 inches away and spray 4–6 pumps of the golden-amber botanical elixir directly onto the scalp roots and thinning zones.

howToUse.title: Invigorate & Massage
howToUse.instruction: Using soft pads of your fingertips (or a wooden scalp massager), massage in circular motions for 3–5 minutes. This awakens dormant follicles and maximizes nutrient absorption.

howToUse.title: Leave In & Nourish
howToUse.instruction: Allow the herbal water elixir to penetrate for at least 2 hours, or leave in overnight for intensive restorative nourishment. Rinse with a gentle, sulfate-free shampoo.
